# Managed by Xray_bash_onekey (Go): idleleo tcp
# Profile: bbr-fq
# Rollback: idleleo tcp rollback
# Do not edit; use the idleleo CLI so rollback stays accurate.
net.core.default_qdisc = fq
net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = bbr
conflicts: /tmp/tcp-override/etc/sysctl.d/99-operator.conf sets net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control=reno after etc/sysctl.d/90-idleleo-tcp.conf; that file wins
impact: applies only net.core.default_qdisc, net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control through /proc/sys; no sysctl --system replay
runtime change is immediate; after reboot the persisted file re-applies the profile
does not install a kernel, BBRPlus, SharpSpeed or a third-party script
